clusters.title: Accountability: Structural Review, Correction Urgency, and Disclosure Terms

op_rules.label: structural review, correction urgency, and disclosure terms

Where loss of life, serious injury, or irreversible rights loss is imminent, is verified or credibly alleged, and was not created by the party or forum relying on it, **CU-1** runs at the **Emergency setting** ([Chapter Seventeen §5 Timely Resolution, Materiality Tiers, and Anti-Delay Discipline](../core_17.000_forum_families_escalation_timeliness_support.md#time-scale-settings) (*Time-scale settings*)): containment screening starts inside its 6-hour intake target and the protective steps finish inside its 3-day bound ([CF-16.445 §5.1](../corpus_forum/cf_16.445_performance_backlog_publication_accessibility.md#cf-16445-51-stage-targets-and-outer-bounds) (*Stage targets and outer bounds*)). Where the containment is a measure in force against someone, notice, restore-challenge, and prompt review run as for any emergency measure ([Chapter Seventeen §5.1 Emergency Measures and Continuation Burden](../core_17.000_forum_families_escalation_timeliness_support.md#51-emergency-measures-and-continuation-burden)). Where a CU issue is also before a forum, that matter's tier window governs, and a CU category never changes a dispute's tier.

The unsafe product or wrong information must be contained inside the containment window and corrected inside the correction window of the matching category (CU-1 to CU-4 of [Correction Urgency (CU) discipline](#correction-urgency-cu-discipline)). [Article III-F](../core_04.000_rights_part_a.md#article-iii-f-safe-products-and-health-information) (*Safe Products and Health Information*) sets the floor; this entry states the working terms. These duties are conditions of offering and are judged as [Commercial Compliance](../subcore_03.090_band_participation.md#commercial-compliance).

Use this sub-rule when a material **classification, typing, or status record** other systems, institutions, forums, or certification cycles rely on is incomplete, contested, understated, or evasive — including the [System Classification Record](../subcore_03.075_band_continuity.md#system-classification-record), the [System Data Types Record](../subcore_03.075_band_continuity.md#system-data-types-record), and comparable owner-layer classification files. Domain anti-evasion lists and required fields stay with the owner file (**Subcore 4-A** (*Data Types*), **CS-8.305 (*System classification machinery*) and Subcore 8-A** (*System Classification*), and peers). How System Alignment Certification treats resulting defects lives under **[Subcore 8-D §4 Certification Outcomes](../subcore_08.040_system_alignment_certification_forum_process_outcomes.md#4-certification-outcomes)**.
Realignment resistance and dissolution-review trigger minimum

Claims over inventions, processes, and other functional works should use `disclosure+15` years as the outer limit of exclusion, followed by an open-licensing phase ending no later than `disclosure+30` years, during which use may not be refused for a published, non-discriminatory, and reviewable fee set in proportion to the invention's verified constitutional benefit measured in LEQU and valued as sentient time saved or added at a fair wage, not market power, and taking no more than half of the verified gain, falling with the number of beneficiaries to a lower limit of 1% without reducing total reward as use widens ([Article XIX-F](../core_04.020_rights_part_c.md#article-xix-f-inventions-processes-and-functional-systems) (*Inventions, Processes, and Functional Systems*)). Shorter terms, compulsory-license conversion, levy-funded reward, or immediate public-access treatment should apply where works are publicly funded, dependency-critical, educationally foundational, safety-relevant, standards-like, or function primarily as cultural memory, civic knowledge, or shared informational infrastructure.
